summary.text: Caldwell Jackson, a Republican, represents House District 80 (Buckfield, Hebron, Otisfield and Oxford, Oxford County) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Oxford. The House profile lists membership on the Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives retired as the occupation and lists affiliations as Selectman of the Town of Oxford and Director of the Oxford County Fair.
It says Jackson is married, to Diane, with three children and eight grandchildren.
